The '''Zelos system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zelos II]] and its primary [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Zelos]].<ref name="PoG2" />
